paragraphs.text: Hras is a man from Selvagr on Bretagard , on the plane of Kaldheim .

Hras is a young man from the village of Sevalgr, about sixteen years old at the time of encountering Kaya Cassir . He displays the effects of living under the shadow of recent tragedies, the unexplained disappearances, and deaths of fellow villagers.

Hras was visibly shaken and fearful when he stepped forward to recount his encounter with a mysterious monster plaguing his town. While talking to Kaya, Hras is tense and withdrawn, rubbing his arms as if cold and avoiding eye contact. He seemed haunted by what he had witnessed, showing a sensitivity and vulnerability uncommon in the harsh environment of Kaldheim . Despite his fear, he bravely stepped forward to share his account with Inga Rune-Eyes and the Omenseekers , who arrived to investigate the village's troubles.

During his testimony, Hras described seeing the monstrous entity responsible for the deaths in Sevalgr, reinforcing the villagers' fears and suspicions. This prompted Inga Rune-Eyes to organize a war party and venture into the Aldergard forest to confront the threat along with the planeswalker Kaya Cassir .
